tools.name: election_changes
tools.description: What changed on Japanese prefectural election schedule pages since a date? From this service's own daily reads: elections added, modified (with before/after dates and the changed fields), removed from the page, and pages that disappeared, became unreadable or came back. tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
